description:
fixes: #2498

Adds trim to `mergeClasses` function. Possibly fixes hydration issues in NextJS.
Also added a test and adjusted GH actions to run this change on each package.

comments.body:
What about doing `return Boolean(className.trim()) && array.indexOf(className) === index;` instead?

That way you don't get something weird if you do `mergeClasses('lucide', ' ', 'lucide-circle')`.

Not sure about the performance impact tho.
Hmm good idea, I will add that one too! Performance is negligible.
